name: Répartiteur des réserves
description: Very broad heavy adult, dark ochre spotted hide, thick neck, wide unmasked mandibles, low squared head crest, black dreads tied low. Heavy short sand-cloth cloak, bronze chest cover and broad belt. Holds a compact bronze ration weighing scale with pans folded inward at waist and a sealed flat supply canister; square travel backpack and two rolled blankets strapped flat on back. Confident planted stance.
